name: Shivendra Kumar
headline: Java Backend Engineer
tagline: Spring Boot · AI Integration · Cloud Data Processing
summary: Software Engineer with nearly 3 years of experience designing and developing Java-based backend applications, enterprise services, and AI-integrated solutions using Java 8/17, Spring Boot, REST APIs, Hibernate/JPA, and PostgreSQL. Hands-on experience building multi-tenant backend systems, AI agent orchestration frameworks, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, and document-processing workflows using Google Gemini, ChromaDB, and OCR. Experienced in cloud-based data processing and analytics with AWS S3, Athena, Glue, Apache Airflow, and TimescaleDB, focusing on query optimization, OAuth 2.0 security, and application modernization.
